snippet.title: Superhero Simulator - Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531260/Superhero_Simulator/?beta=0
Superhero Simulator drops you into a massive open-world city where being a hero isn’t just about flying and fighting crime. You’ll rescue people from burning buildings, stop robberies in progress, and face dangerous threats—but also deal with real-life problems like paying rent, affording new clothes, and keeping your energy up. Live a double life as a struggling citizen and a city-saving icon. Can you handle both?
